title: Hearty Sweet Vietnamese Tofu Noodles
description: A sweet and pillowy Vietnamese dish featuring sriracha and smoke, perfect for kids and shojin-friendly diets. This dish is easy to make and fun to eat.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sriracha sauce, smoked paprika, and soy sauce.
Pour the sauce over the tofu and onions, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce and tofu.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
